text_block_list.text: When I came to inspect a certain race—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, this is—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the track is a total mess.
Yesterday's rain really was crazy...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No wayyy~!
They said the condition would be peak today~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, the worst.
I wonder if I can even run according to strategy...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Hehehe, isn't this absolute perfection!
Just as calculated!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Haha!
Hahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Air Shakur is laughing.
Is she gonna be all right...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Looks like today's race will be wild again...
Hope it doesn't end in a mid-race withdrawal or something.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Shakur-san.
P-Please do your best today.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You here, Doto?!
Hehehe, great weather today, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? 
Um, but the sky is completely gloomy and overcast...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes it great!
Blazing hot sunshine is just annoying, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This stage is practically made for me!
Hehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Shakur-san, somehow...
you're in a much higher spirit than usual...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, of course I am!
Every single factor fell right into place!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No mistake about it, I'm unstoppable today.
—I'm gonna win by a mile.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And from the very back of the pack, at that!
I'll overtake the whole field right before the straight. Sounds fun, don't it?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But with this bad track condition...
It might even rain again after this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That crap's within margin of error.
If there's any problem at all...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-If there is...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—It's that I'm so hyped up,
I might just blow my own lid!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Feels like adrenaline's pumping out like crazy!
Man, today is gonna be wild as hell.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
None of them think I'm gonna win either.
Hehehe, time to line up some dumbfounded faces!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eep, thunder...?! 
Sh-Shakur-san...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't flinch, Doto.
Just shut up and keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Hahaha...!
I'll prove it, right in front of every single spectator!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That my theory is the strongest!!

—And on that day, Air Shakur took 1st place
by a massive margin, sending shockwaves through the venue.
